name: abstention_accuracy
description: Did the method decline exactly when it should? Unanswerable items (metadata answerable=false, or an empty reference) score 1 if the prediction abstains; answerable items score 1 if it does not. Reports {accuracy, unanswerable_recall, answerable_precision...}. Abstention is detected by keyword ("not mentioned", "no information", "cannot answer", ...). Opt in per dataset via meta.json extra_metrics (longmemeval, groupmembench, molweni, beam).
